title: Building a free tool to check prop firm breach rules. need real breached-account trade history.
author: _dat58
selftext:
Hey all, I'm building a rule-checker for prop firm challenges (FTMO/E8/Topstep-style drawdown, consistency, and news-window rules) as a hackathon project. The goal is something that reads a firm's rulebook and a trade log, then tells you exactly which rule you'd breach and when, before it costs you an account.

I have some of my own breached account history to work with, but I'd love a few more real examples to make sure it actually holds up across different firms and breach types.

If you've had a funded/challenge account breached, could you share:

A dashboard export, CSV, or statement of the trade history (or even clear screenshots of the trade table)

Roughly which rule you think you broke, if you know (daily drawdown, max drawdown, consistency, news trading, etc.)

Before sending, please:

Redact your name, account number, and anything else identifying

Just the trades themselves are what I need, timestamps, position size, P&L, balance/equity

Totally fine to DM instead of posting publicly. Happy to share the project results and credit anyone who contributes once it's done. No payment involved, this is a hobby/hackathon build, not a commercial thing.

Time crunch, I'm working against a deadline, so anything by the 29th is most useful, but I'll take it whenever.

Thanks in advance.
